idle.action: proud idle: smooth slow breathing - belly swells and shrinks, crown tilts slightly, cape sways, one blink; stays in place, same size, evenly spaced in-between poses for a smooth loop

hurt.action: hit by a dart: recoils backwards with big shocked eyes, spins dizzy with swirly eyes, then slumps and collapses flat, defeated (x-eyes) in the last frame; no detached effects, same character, evenly spaced in-between poses
